question: As a General Practitioner focused on public health education, what are the key characteristics of COVID-19, including its cause, common symptoms, and the most effective preventive measures that I should communicate to my community?
reference_answer: COVID-19 is an infectious disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus. Most people experience mild to moderate respiratory illness, but some can become seriously ill, especially older individuals and those with underlying medical conditions. Common symptoms include fever, cough, and tiredness. To prevent the spread of COVID-19, individuals should get vaccinated, stay at least 1 meter apart from others, wear a properly fitted mask, choose open and well-ventilated spaces, open a window if indoors, wash hands regularly with soap and water or an alcohol-based hand rub, cover their mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, stay home and self-isolate if unwell, and practice respiratory etiquette.
